message: Ever been caught off guard by a blackout? I have! Nothing quite like rummaging through drawers for a flashlight while the fridge hums ominously. 😅 This resource from Ready.gov is a handy guide for prepping your home for those unexpected outages. It’s all about having a plan so you can laugh off the chaos instead of scrambling in the dark. What’s your favorite tip for staying ready? Let’s hear it!
